notes: «وَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» opens the ruling, and the chain after it runs to Abu Ja'far, who is a narrator after «عَنْ» (owner ruling 2). Ali is not added as a link. «وَ رَوَاهُ اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ» names another transmitter for the same ruling: a variant group (rule 4).
